build.buildCommand: npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npx prisma generate --schema=apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build -w apps/api

deploy.startCommand: cd apps/api && npx prisma migrate deploy --schema=./prisma/schema.prisma && if [ "$SEED_DEMO" = "yes" ]; then SEED_ALLOW_REMOTE=yes node dist/seed.backoffice.js; fi && node dist/index.js
